item.title: Luka Dončić considered day-to-day with mild hamstring strain
item.description: The Lakers might be finishing up the first half of their season without Luka Dončić. item.title: Lakers fend off fiesty Warriors for third straight win
item.description: With both teams missing stars, the Lakers controlled much of the second half of Saturday’s game against the Warriors, earning a 105-99 win. item.title: Lakers sign Kobe Bufkin to two-year deal
item.description: The Lakers moved quickly after the trade deadline to sign their 15th and final player. On Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reported that the Lakers were signing Kobe Bufkin to a two-year deal with the second year being a player option.
